scope: Development cohort. Main means and population variances are across six instances per family; generation variance is separately computed on the frozen number of independent requests per panel instance. Generation panels remain small and uncertain; sample degrees of freedom equal the observed request count minus one. NA means inapplicable or unobserved, never zero. Deterministic rescore and stochastic judge variance are separate studies. Replayed paid receipts count once.
